answer: Farming becomes a comet bet on surviving 115 epochs of grading, and every quill settlement recomputes the copper schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 115 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
